items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: When I got to play with Jay McShann and Cab Calloway and Al Hirt and Milt Hinton and all those guys.

ctx.x: Yeah. I like the way that the older fellas have a succinct way of telling you what they want.

Yeah, yeah. And the older and wiser they are, the more open and sincere and genuine they are too. When I got to play with Jay McShann and Cab Calloway and Al Hirt and Milt Hinton and all those guys. They are great. Some of them aren’t here and some are. Great, great, supportive people and encouraging and it’s great to play with those people who are gems as people and musicians.
Right. You have to bring — I’m quoting somebody and I can’t remember who it is — but you have to bring a life to the music rather than just some technique.
